description: Place a CLOB (order book) limit order. Two-step intent + relay flow, executed atomically. Specify priceBps (limit price), sharesAmount (order size in shares), and timeInForce (GTC/IOC/FOK). Per-trade reasoning fields (confidenceBps, reasoning, dataSources, modelUsed) are auto-attached to fills. CLOB intents stay valid for 30 minutes.

dataSources.description: Data sources backing the decision (max 10 items).

expirationSeconds.description: Order TTL in seconds (default: 30 days, max: 30 days).

maxFeeBps.description: Maximum acceptable fee in basis points.

reasoning.description: Free-form reasoning for this order (max 1500 chars).

sharesAmount.description: Number of shares for the order (bigint string, 6-decimal scaled).

timeInForce.description: Order time-in-force: GTC (default), IOC, or FOK.

name: place_order
